note: Generation traces of the readouts in results/, one gzipped JSONL sidecar per readout (OUT.traces.jsonl.gz beside OUT.json or OUT.json.gz). Record keys: id, sample, think (reasoning token ids, Qwen3.5 tokenizer), answers (answer text per budget). No problem or gold-answer text. The files are the lab files byte for byte: the publication scrub rules of results/SCRUB_LEDGER.json match nothing in them, so sha256 (the file) is also the lab file's hash and sha256_released is the uncompressed content. See results/TRACES_README.md.
